What it represents: Top-level Azure DevOps Services boundary
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Logging and auditing coverage: Ownership, tenant linkage and lifecycle changes.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable Log Audit Events per Entra-backed organisation. Native audit retention is 90 days; export or stream for longer retention. This matrix targets Services; the organisation auditing feature is not available in Azure DevOps Server.

What it represents: Organisation-wide access and security settings
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended validation: compare policy snapshots and test effective access. Policy configuration does not prove that every access attempt is logged.

What it represents: Container for repositories, boards, pipelines and permissions
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended correlation: retain project ID as well as name; distinguish requested operations from successful completion.

What it represents: Azure DevOps security group and its members
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; Microsoft Entra audit logs
Additional execution / operational evide: Entra-managed group additions/removals require Entra audit logs. Recommended correlation: combine direct membership, inherited groups and effective permissions.

What it represents: Access grants, denials and inheritance on protected objects
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended validation: retain security namespace, resource token and subject identity, and resolve the effective permission after changes.

What it represents: Version-controlled source-code repository
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; Azure Repos history
Additional execution / operational evide: Use commits, pushes and pull-request records for code history. Do not infer comprehensive repository read/clone coverage from lifecycle auditing; validate the organisation's available audit actions.

What it represents: Rules governing changes to a branch
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended correlation: inspect pull requests, votes, checks and merge commits to establish which version entered the branch.

What it represents: A proposed or completed source change
Primary audit source: Azure Repos records; service hooks where configured
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported push and pull-request notifications supplement repository history.
Additional execution / operational evide: Configure and retain selected service-hook events; notification coverage is not a complete organisation audit feed. Recommended correlation: project, repository, PR and commit IDs.

What it represents: Build or deployment workflow and its configuration
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; repository history
Additional execution / operational evide: Retain YAML and template revisions alongside the run. Audit events alone do not reconstruct executed scripts or every referenced dependency.

What it represents: One execution of a pipeline and its steps
Primary audit source: Azure Pipelines run records and logs
Additional execution / operational evide: Download run logs or collect them through supported APIs. Enable System.Debug for detailed troubleshooting; collect required custom files explicitly. Organisation audit streaming does not automatically export task logs.

What it represents: Classic release definition and deployments
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; release logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Definition, release, deployment and approval events.
Additional execution / operational evide: Retain stage/task logs and target-side evidence to verify what changed. Keep classic release IDs distinct from YAML run IDs.

What it represents: Named deployment target and associated resources
Primary audit source: Environment deployment history; Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Logging and auditing coverage: Deployment-completion events and environment execution history.
Additional execution / operational evide: Deployment jobs must reference the environment/resource for associated history. Use target-platform logs to verify actual application or infrastructure changes.

What it represents: Gate controlling use of a protected pipeline resource
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; pipeline check results
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended evidence: retain approver decisions and check results with the run; do not treat check configuration as proof that a deployment was approved.

What it represents: Configured identity and endpoint for an external service
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; pipeline logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Connection lifecycle, sharing and execution events.
Additional execution / operational evide: Correlate connection usage with run ID, service identity and destination logs. An execution event does not enumerate every downstream API operation.

What it represents: Reusable pipeline variables and secret references
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended evidence: version nonsecret configuration and retain pipeline context. Do not export secret values into the logging catalogue.

What it represents: Protected file consumed by pipeline tasks
Primary audit source: Pipeline task logs; applicable resource-authorisation audit events
Logging and auditing coverage: Validate available actions; do not assume complete file-access auditing.
Additional execution / operational evide: Retain authorised pipeline/task context and review the current audit actions catalogue for explicit secure-file events. Avoid treating the broad Library area description as proof of a specific download event.

What it represents: Execution pool and its registered workers
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: For self-hosted workers, separately collect host security, process and agent diagnostics. Registration events do not prove host integrity or continuous availability.

What it represents: Worker process executing jobs on a host
Primary audit source: Agent and worker diagnostic logs; host telemetry
Logging and auditing coverage: Worker troubleshooting and optional additional network diagnostics.
Additional execution / operational evide: Use Agent.Diagnostic where supported. Collect self-hosted operating-system/endpoint evidence separately; preserve required logs before ephemeral workers disappear.

What it represents: Package distribution container and scoped view
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended supplemental evidence: package provenance and pipeline publish/restore output. Do not assume feed administration auditing captures every package download.

What it represents: Tracked requirement, task, bug or change
Primary audit source: Azure Boards history / Work Item Tracking REST API
Additional execution / operational evide: Retrieve revisions or updates for the item. Organisation auditing is not a replacement for work-item history; use item ID and revision for correlation.

What it represents: Work tracking schema and project classification
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended correlation: compare configuration with affected work items and team workflows; schema changes and individual item edits are separate evidence.

What it represents: Test management and recorded execution outcomes
Primary audit source: Azure Test Plans / pipeline test results
Logging and auditing coverage: Run and result evidence, including failures and attachments.
Additional execution / operational evide: Retain results according to project policy and publish automated test results from pipelines. Test outcomes are operational evidence, not a complete security audit trail.

What it represents: Outbound event notification integration
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; service-hook delivery history
Logging and auditing coverage: Subscription lifecycle/status changes; delivery request/response history.
Additional execution / operational evide: Collect delivery diagnostics and receiver logs. Recommended checks: delivery failures, disabled subscriptions and destination changes.

What it represents: Installed Azure DevOps marketplace capability
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended supplemental evidence: publisher/version inventory, requested permissions and extension-specific execution output.

What it represents: Credentials for noninteractive access
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Logging and auditing coverage: Credential lifecycle events; not token-use auditing.
Additional execution / operational evide: Do not interpret creation or revocation records as a history of requests authenticated with that credential. Investigate resource actions and endpoint evidence separately.

What it represents: Authentication by a person, service principal or managed identity
Primary audit source: Microsoft Entra sign-in logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Relevant user, service-principal and managed-identity authentication events.
Additional execution / operational evide: Azure DevOps organisation auditing does not record sign-ins. Select the appropriate Entra log type; token-based requests do not necessarily cause a new Entra sign-in event for every call.

What it represents: Audit access and onward delivery configuration
Example instance: Azure DevOps audit stream to Splunk HEC
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log; destination ingestion monitoring
Logging and auditing coverage: Audit access and stream administration events.
Additional execution / operational evide: Stream to Splunk HEC, Azure Monitor Logs (AzureDevOpsAuditing) or Event Grid. Delivery is batched, normally within 30 minutes. Recommended validation: generate a known event and confirm arrival and retention.

What it represents: Service subscription and user entitlement configuration
Primary audit source: Azure DevOps Services organisation audit log
Additional execution / operational evide: Recommended correlation: reconcile entitlement changes with approved onboarding/offboarding and current user/group inventory.
